EffectModifierDef.description:
An attribute modifier the effect gives while it lasts. The amount is the first level's: vanilla multiplies it
by the amplifier + 1, so Slowness II (amplifier 1) slows twice as much as Slowness I, unless ``per_amplifier`` (or
``per_amplifier_percent``) gives what each level above the first adds instead (Battle Shout's 10, 15 and 20 %,
Matěj, 2026-10-30). Units follow the stat rules: multiplied operations take ``amount_percent``; ``add_value`` on
one of our stats takes its unit.

amount_percent.description: The amount in percent (5 means 5 %, the fraction 0.05).
amount_percent.title: Amount Percent

attribute.description: The attribute it modifies, e.g. realmforge:strength.
attribute.title: Attribute

operation.description: How the amount applies (vanilla's attribute modifier operations).
operation.title: Operation

per_amplifier.description: Added for every amplifier level above the first, in the amount's units, instead of vanilla's multiplying the amount by the level.
per_amplifier.title: Per Amplifier

per_amplifier_percent.description: per_amplifier in percent, for an amount_percent.
per_amplifier_percent.title: Per Amplifier Percent

EffectModifierDef.title: EffectModifierDef

LocalizedText.description: A player-facing text, keyed by locale. Realmforge ships English only, so en_us is the one locale.
LocalizedText.title: LocalizedText

PeriodicDef.description:
Damage or healing of a spell school at the end of every interval while the effect lasts (damage or healing
over time). One tick is (amount + its share of the caster's Spell Power) times (1 + the school's power), scaling
system C (RLM-534): a damage over time splits its spell's coefficient over its ticks. Each amplifier level adds the
tick again. The caster's stats count as each tick lands. Ticks never crit.

amount.description: Damage or healing of one tick at the first level (amplifier 0).
amount.title: Amount

interval_seconds.description: The time between two ticks, from 0.25 to 10 s.
interval_seconds.title: Interval Seconds

spell_power_percent.description: Share of the caster's Spell Power (points) one tick adds at the first level, in percent (a magic school only). Without it, Spell Power adds nothing.
spell_power_percent.title: Spell Power Percent

type.description: damage: a hit of the school; heal: healing.
type.title: Type

PeriodicDef.title: PeriodicDef

StacksDef.description:
Damage over time that each caster's spell keeps on a target as a stack of its own (RLM-539, Bleeding): the
spell that applies it (``realmforge:damage_over_time``) names how much it deals in all, fixed from the caster's
stats when it is applied, and its ticks split that evenly. Two spells, or two casters, stack; the same spell from
the same caster refreshes its stack. The status effect shows while any stack lasts. Ticks never crit, are never
dodged or blocked, and never knock back.

ignores_armor.description: Whether its ticks ignore the target's armor, as bleeds do in WoW.
ignores_armor.title: Ignores Armor

interval_seconds.description: The time between two ticks, from 0.25 to 10 s.
interval_seconds.title: Interval Seconds

school.description: The spell school of its ticks, e.g. realmforge:physical.
school.title: School

StacksDef.title: StacksDef

description:
A status effect of ours, ``realmforge:<id>``: harmful, beneficial or neutral, with attribute modifiers, damage
or healing over time, or both. Its name is the effect's translation, ``effect.realmforge.<id>``, shown in the
inventory and on the HUD with its icon (a placeholder until the art exists).

category.description: beneficial: a buff; harmful: a debuff (it can be dispelled as one); neutral: neither.
category.title: Category

id.description: Lowercase snake_case id; becomes realmforge:<id>. Must equal the file name.
id.title: Id

look.description: How clients draw its holder: ice covers its body in Packed Ice and makes it shiver (Frozen, RLM-539).
look.title: Look

modifiers.description: Attribute modifiers it gives while it lasts.
modifiers.title: Modifiers

name.description: The effect's name, shown with its icon.

periodic.description: Damage or healing at the end of every interval while it lasts.

stacks.description: Damage over time kept per caster's spell (RLM-539, Bleeding): the spell that applies it through realmforge:damage_over_time names the damage, fixed when applied. Instead of periodic.

stun.description: A stun (C4): its holder neither attacks nor casts, a mob's AI stands still, and a cast in progress is interrupted. Harmful only; its modifiers stop movement (movement_speed and jump_strength at -100 % add_multiplied_total).
stun.title: Stun
